content.lede: Questions about the program, hiring our troops, or partnering with us. Write in and a person on the team will answer.

texts.content: 31860 Sandy Plains Road, Ste 204 PMB 206, Marietta, GA 30066

response_time.title: Response time
response_time.content: We answer inside two business days. Application status questions go to the team that reviews your cohort.

section_title.title: Contact us with this form and we will get back to you as soon as possible

items.title: What does it cost?
items.description: Nothing. Vets Who Code is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit and the program is free to every troop who is accepted. EIN 86-2122804.

items.title: Who is eligible?
items.description: U.S. military veterans and military spouses. No prior experience with software is required.

items.title: How long is the program?
items.description: 17 weeks, remote-first. It is not a bootcamp. Every hour of instruction maps to verified labor market demand.

items.title: Do I apply through this form?
items.description: No. Applications run through Apply Now. Use this form for questions the application does not cover.

items.title: Can I visit the address listed?
items.description: The Marietta address is a mailing address for official correspondence, not a campus. Instruction is remote.

items.title: We want to hire or partner.
items.description: Pick the hiring or partnership reason above, or mail hello@vetswhocode.io directly. Veterans are stakeholders, not charity cases.
